title: Byline bios and credit lists (sample)
summary: A made-up change built on the real byline routes, to show the format. Editors get a short bio on each byline and a list of what that byline is credited on. The photo moves from a bare asset id to an object carrying its URL, which is the one breaking change.
diagram:
graph LR
  P["PATCH /bylines/:byline_id"] -->|write| B[(bylines)]
  P -->|write| R[(public_resources)]
  C["GET /bylines/:byline_id/credits"] -->|read| EB[(expressions__bylines)]
  C -->|read| E[(expressions)]
  C -->|read| R

questions.question: How should the photo change reach existing callers?
questions.context: Replacing `photo_asset_id` with `photo` breaks the Creator's byline form until it is updated in the same release.
options: Replace it outright and update the Creator form in the same PR
Return both `photo_asset_id` and `photo` for one release, then drop the old field
Keep `photo_asset_id` and leave the URL lookup to the client

questions.question: Should the bio allow formatting?
options: A small Markdown subset (links and emphasis)
